title: वैदिक साहित्य में संगीत एवं सौन्दर्य का परस्पर सम्बन्ध
journal: International Journal of Social Nexus Review
abstract: सृष्टि दो प्रकार की है- एक ब्रह्म की और दूसरी मनुष्य की। दोनों सृष्टियों के मूल में आनन्द प्राप्त करने की भावना सन्निहित है। प्रजापति ने सृष्टि इसलिये की कि वह अकेला था और उसको अपना अकेलापन अच्छा नहीं लगा। उसके मन में ‘‘एको ऽहं बहु स्याम” मैं एक हूँ अनेक हो जाऊँ की इच्छा उत्पन्न हुई। इस इच्छा के उत्पन्न होते ही यह सम्पूर्ण सृष्टि सत्ता में आई। यह विविध सृष्टि अपनी समस्त विशिष्टताओं के साथ ब्रह्मा की अद्भुत कला थी जिसकी सर्जनात्मकता अनन्तकाल से निरन्तर अबाध रूप से चलती आई है और अनन्त काल तक चलती रहेगी। इसी अभिप्राय को लक्ष्य कर वेद के ऋषि ने ‘‘पश्य देवस्य काव्यं न ममार न जीर्यति” अर्थात् देव के काव्य को देखो, यह न तो कभी मरता है और न ही कभी जीर्ण होता है। ब्रह्मा ने आनन्द की प्राप्ति के लिये तथा अकेलापन दूर करने के लिये सृष्टि रूप कला का निर्माण किया। अपनी कला को देखकर उसका अकेलापन दूर हुआ या नहीं, अथवा आनन्द की प्राप्ति हुई या नहीं, यह तो हम देख नहीं सकते, किन्तु अपनी बुद्धि से उसका अनुमान तो अवश्य लगा सकते हैं। मानव स्वयं उस कला का एक अंग होकर उसका आनन्द लेता रहा है। मानव सृष्टि ब्रह्मा की सृष्टिकला का एक अंग है, किन्तु वह ब्रह्मा की सृष्टि का आनन्द लेता हुआ भी केवल उसी से सन्तुष्ट नहीं हुआ। वह सन्तुष्ट हो भी कैसे सकता था? ब्रह्मा ने मानव सृष्टि तो की किन्तु ब्रह्मत्व की सृष्टि नहीं की। इसी ब्रह्मत्व की खोज में मानव बेचैन रहा। ब्रह्मत्व का दर्शन कभी सृष्टि के विभिन्न तत्त्वों में करता, कभी इनसे परे करता। श्तत् सृष्ट्वा तदेवानुप्रातिशत् इस श्रुति ने उसको यह बताया कि वह ब्रह्मा इस संसार की सृष्टि कर इसी में प्रविष्ट हो गया है, इसलिये इसी में उसको खोजना चाहिये। किसी ने यह बताया कि ब्रह्म अपनी कृति में समाविष्ट नहीं हो सकता, वह तो उससे अलग है, इसलिये उसकी कृति में उसको खोजना ठीक नहीं। प्लेटो ने इसीलिये कहा कि यह समस्त प्रकृति परमात्मा की कृति वा अनुकृति है स्वयं परमात्मा नहीं, इसलिये उसमें परमात्मा का दर्शन नहीं हो सकता। आचार्य शंकर आदि दार्शनिकों ने भी यही मत व्यक्त किया। इन दार्शनिकों ने जगत् को मिथ्या माना तथा प्रकारान्तर से ब्रह्मा की कला में अनास्था व्यक्त की। उन्होंने अपनी दृष्टि से परमात्मा की कला से ऊपर उठकर ब्रह्मत्व का विवेचन दार्शनिक पृष्ठभूमि में किया। किन्तु वह विवेचन सर्वजन सुलभ एवं इन्द्रियग्राह्य नहीं हो सका। ब्रह्म तत्त्व किस प्रकार इन्द्रियग्राह्य हो सकेगा इसकी खोज में मानव ने विभिन्न कलाओं की सृष्टि की। काव्यकला संगीत कला, एवं वास्तुकला ये तीन कलायें ही परब्रह्म तत्व को क्रमशः रस ब्रह्म, नाद ब्रह्म, तथा वास्तु-ब्रह्म के रूप में अपना प्रतिपाद्य ग्रहण करती है, इसलिये परब्रह्म के साथ इनका सम्बन्ध होने के कारण ये स्वतन्त्र कलायें कहलाती है। अन्य कलायें जो उपयोगितामूलक धरातल पर प्रतिष्ठित हैं, आश्रित कहलाती है।

title: Women’s Participation, Human Resource Management, and Local Natural Resource Governance: A Conceptual Analysis of Panchayati Raj Institutions in Una District, Himachal Pradesh, India
abstract: Panchayati Raj institutions (PRIs) have become increasingly significant for decentralised local governance and may be relevant for the management of natural resources, including forest, grazing and water. With the adoption of the 73rd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1992, the women’s quota in PRIs has increased their representation in local governance formally. Nevertheless, numerical representation does not always mean effective participation and influence on natural resource governance. The objective of this study is to analyse theoretically the relationship between women’s participation, human resource management (HRM), and local natural resource governance, especially in the case of Una district, Himachal Pradesh. Based on literature on decentralised governance, gender, common pool resources, reservation policy, and public sector HRM, a theoretical framework is developed. This study underlines the significance of taking into account the institutional conditions along with representation, keeping in mind that the impacts vary based on the context. The conceptual analysis highlights that formal representation is not sufficient to achieve effective participation, and that capacity development, role clarification, and institutional support may possibly explain this relationship. Its main contribution lies in bringing into consideration public sector HRM issues in the analysis of gender-inclusive local natural resource governance. The study does not provide empirical data related to a specific district nor does it develop any causal relations; rather it poses research questions and indicator examples for further empirical study in Una district.

title: When, where, and in whom does recurrence occur after radical cystectomy for pathologically confirmed non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer? Implications for risk-adapted surveillance
When processing feels smooth: brand placement mode and contextual influences on purchase intentions
abstract: Purpose This study aims to use processing fluency as an integrative lens to examine why placement prominence does not yield a stable persuasive advantage and how contextual influences shape explicit and implicit placement effectiveness in narrative media. Design/methodology/approach Four between-subjects experiments (2 × 2 factorial designs) were conducted using authentic Korean drama clips. Each study examined one potential disruption source: product category, brand familiarity, endorser image valence or parasocial interaction, comparing explicit and implicit placement with purchase intention as the dependent variable (n = 616). Findings Results were consistent with a processing-fluency explanation. Product category and parasocial interaction (PSI) each interacted with placement mode (ps < 0.001): explicit placement favored search goods and low-PSI characters, whereas implicit placement favored experience goods and high-PSI characters. Brand familiarity moderated effects (p = 0.039), with a larger implicit-placement advantage for unfamiliar brands. The endorser-valence study showed main effects only. Practical implications Managers should tailor placement modes to contextual conditions rather than maximize visibility, reducing potential disruption to viewing experiences and enhancing purchase intentions. Originality/value This research uses contextual processing demands to interpret crossover, asymmetric and additive placement effects beyond specific forms of fit and congruence. The framework complements persuasion-knowledge accounts by considering narrative disruption alongside resistance to persuasive intent. This integrative explanation of prominence’s variable persuasive value requires direct tests of the underlying processes.

title: The role of crowding and decision comfort during sales periods
abstract: Purpose Sales periods simultaneously attract consumers through price reductions and trigger avoidance behaviors: a paradox this study addresses by examining decision comfort as a potential mediator of the effects of human and spatial crowding on visit postponement and store-switching. Gender is also examined as a moderator of these relationships. Design/methodology/approach A quantitative approach was adopted, with data collected from 378 consumers in France during official sales periods across several retail locations. The conceptual model was tested using structural equation modeling (SEM) to examine relationships among perceived crowding, decision comfort, visit postponement, and store-switching. Multi-group analysis assessed gender differences. Findings Both human and spatial crowding were negatively associated with decision comfort. Lower decision comfort was associated with higher levels of visit postponement and, less robustly, with store-switching. The indirect effect of spatial crowding on visit postponement through decision comfort was supported; the indirect effects of human crowding on both avoidance behaviors were also supported but modest in magnitude, whereas the indirect effect of spatial crowding on store-switching was not supported. Gender differences were detected in the crowding–decision comfort relationships, whereas no gender differences were detected in the decision comfort–avoidance paths. Originality/value This research contributes to the marketing literature by showing that the mediating role of decision comfort depends on the form of crowding and the avoidance response considered. It extends the application of decision comfort as an emerging construct in the retail context, offering new insights into how crowding shapes consumer decision-making. The study also identifies gender differences in the crowding–decision comfort relationships and provides managerial implications for improving retail experiences during sales.

title: The origins and development of the National Flood Insurance Program
journal: Journal of Political Institutions and Political Economy
abstract: We explore the emergence and development of federal flood insurance over time. After a couple of false starts in the 1950s, Congress passed the National Flood Insurance Act of 1968, which established the National Flood Insurance Program (NFIP). The NFIP sought to provide federally subsidized flood insurance in high-risk flood zones, with premium inflows intended to cover claims-payment outflows. While the NFIP struggled financially through the early 21st century, its fragile administrative structure was laid bare by Hurricanes Katrina and Rita. Beginning in 2005, claims payments drove the NFIP deeply into the red. After several years of politicking, Congress acted to reform the NFIP by reducing the subsidization of premiums and making the program more actuarially sound. But members backpedaled quickly after homeowners organized and threatened electoral sanctions – and the reforms were largely undone. We find that the polarization inherent in today’s party system makes coordinating on flood insurance reform difficult, as Democrats and Republicans advocate for different things. That said, members from districts/states that have been hit hard by flooding, regardless of party, tend toward maintaining federally subsidized premiums rather than promoting actuarial soundness.

title: The energising experience of psychological need fulfilment: a person-centred approach
abstract: Purpose Energy is important at work. The self-determination theory posits that to increase employee energy, individuals must have three fundamental psychological needs fulfilled: autonomy, competence and relatedness. We take a person-centred approach to the experience of need fulfilment for energy at work. Design/methodology/approach Across two studies, we investigate psychological needs profiles and their relationship to energy during times in which employees exerted extra effort at work. We utilise latent profile analysis. Findings We discover five profiles of need fulfilment and tested their relationship to energy during the event: high-level, low-level, competence-driven, upper-middle and lower-middle. Participants whose needs were highly fulfilled (high-level need fulfilment class) reported the highest mean energy levels. Originality/value Previous research has often taken a variable-centred approach, conflated need fulfilment and need thwarting and/or only considered need fulfilment profiles related to negative outcomes. Our study extends this research by investigating need fulfilment profiles related to energy at work.

title: The emerging research frontier of food analytics: artificial intelligence, consumer analytics, smart food systems and knowledge-driven intelligence
abstract: Purpose This study examines the emerging research frontier of Food Analytics between 2016 and mid-2026. It identifies descriptors that show sustained novelty and growth, analyses how they combine into emergent thematic clusters, and synthesizes these clusters into broader research dimensions that shape the field's current research frontier. Design/methodology/approach The study adopts a technological-intelligence design based on bibliometric tech mining and analyzes 1,967 Scopus-indexed publications using descriptor normalization, Porter's emergence indicators, document-level co-word analysis, and Louvain community detection. Emergent descriptors were identified using temporal growth and novelty criteria, clustered by co-occurrence, and interpreted comparatively to derive higher-order analytical dimensions. Findings The analysis identified 111 emergent descriptors organized into five Louvain communities after a sensitivity analysis of the emergence-ratio threshold and evaluation of cluster coverage and interpretability. The five-community solution was synthesized into four substantive dimensions: intelligent food quality and composition analytics; predictive and operational food-system analytics; personalized nutrition and consumer analytics; and semantic, generative, and knowledge-driven food analytics. The difference between the five communities and four dimensions reflects the integration of a predominantly methodological community across the substantive dimensions in which its methods are applied. Originality/value The study moves beyond technology-specific reviews by identifying emergence at the descriptor level and integrating overlapping clusters into a coherent framework of research dimensions. It provides a forward-looking account of how Food Analytics is expanding and clarifies the technological, methodological, and application areas most likely to shape its next stage of development.
